task: Predict lymph node presentation status in esophageal carcinoma. Classes: Node_Negative vs. Node_Positive. H&E features associated with nodal spread include lymphovascular invasion, deeper invasion, poor differentiation, infiltrative borders, and tumor budding.

classes.0: Node-negative tumor lacking strong H&E evidence of metastatic propensity such as conspicuous lymphovascular invasion or marked infiltrative budding.
classes.1: Node-positive tumor with aggressive morphology, especially lymphovascular invasion, infiltrative growth, tumor budding, or poor differentiation.
